description.zh:
指定机器的类型：
- 1：查询机器地址
- 2：查询机器标签
description.en:
The information type of the specified workers that you want to query. Valid values: 1 and 2.

1: the IP address of the specified workers.
2: the tags of the specified workers.

description.zh: 应用ID，在控制台的**应用管理**页面中获取
description.en: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the Applications page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 任务ID，在控制台的任务管理页面中获取
description.en: The job ID. You can obtain the ID on the Tasks page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 命名空间UID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
description.en: The unique identifier (UID) of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace UID on the Namespaces page in the SchedulerX console.

description.zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

title.zh: 获取任务指定的机器详细信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 read-schedulerx-designate-detail --job-id 368 --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id test.defalutGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --designate-type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
